name: host-member-own-budget-ends
description: Teams Phase 2 (rule 53's scope): billing's own thread budget, a lifetime cap for a host member, runs out in the turn that took support's ask. The append ends the member (budget_exceeded{scope: thread}, turn_completed{budget_exhausted}, member_ended{budget_exhausted}), so rule 53 does not apply: no turn_failed bounce and no member_idle. The taken ask stays open until its deadline, and support stays parked. The supervisor stops the member: an own-budget end never restarts.
